title: Monthly all-hands (mostly announcements and past actions)

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Okay, welcome everyone to the July all-hands. Happy Friday. We have a short agenda, a few announcements, some wins, and then questions.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Happy Friday!

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Hello hello.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Morning.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Morning all.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: First, the wins. The Reserve plan launched last week and it's already got forty signups.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Forty-three, actually, I checked this morning.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Forty-three, even better. Great job, everyone.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: The portal held up, no incidents.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Nice, thank you Marcus. And the Lantern beta, how did that go?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: We shipped it on the fourteenth like we planned. Harbor Cafe has been on it for two weeks. The feedback is good.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: They love the new checkout. I got two thank-you emails.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: That's lovely. Priya, the supplier thing.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Yeah, Lotus Valley is on board as the backup. Tom signed the order form on Monday and the first sample arrived Tuesday.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: And Marcus did the quality check already, it passed.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: It was fine. Moisture was good. I posted the results in the channel last week.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Brilliant. So everything from last month's list is done. That's rare.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: We should celebrate.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: We will. That leads to the next item. For the next all-hands we want to meet in person, in the office, rather than on a huddle. Is everyone okay with that?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Yes please.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Yes, I'm in.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Works for me. I can bring cake.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Great. So the next all-hands is in the office. Decided.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Then I'll need to book the space. I'll book the office for the next all-hands by next Friday.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Next Friday, the tenth. Thank you Priya.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Yes.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Oh, and the expense policy. Finance has changed the rules for travel, receipts over fifty euros now need approval before the trip.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Right, that one is important. Tom, can you send it round?

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Yes, I'll send the new expense policy to everyone. Probably Monday, but I'll see what finance says.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: No problem.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Does it apply to client dinners too?

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: It does. Everything.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Ugh. Okay.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: By the way, the Wi-Fi in the meeting room is fixed. I replaced the access point on Wednesday.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Thanks, I noticed the call was smooth. Also I already sent the holiday calendar to everyone, did that arrive?

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Yes, got it.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Got it.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Good. Moving on. Priya, did you want to say something about the hiring?

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Yeah, we hired the marketing coordinator. She starts the first of August. Sofia interviewed her last month.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: She's great. I had a long chat with her, she knows the tea market well.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Welcome her when she arrives. Now, for questions. Does anyone have a question for me?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Is there going to be a bonus this year?

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Ask me again in December. I really don't know yet.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Ha, fair.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Is the office moving?

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Not this year. If it were, you would know.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Maybe we should collect questions from the team beforehand next time? So that people who are shy can ask anonymously.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: That's a good idea. Like a form.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Interesting. I'm not sure how we'd do it yet. Let's keep it as an idea.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Sure.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Hey, did the thing with the coffee machine get sorted?

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: The coffee machine was replaced, yes. Marcus brought a new one on Monday.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: It is the good one.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: Does the new one do oat milk?

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: It does. And the grinder is quiet.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: That is the real win of the quarter.

transcript.speaker: Dana Okafor
transcript.text: Alright, anything else? No? Then thank you, everybody, have a great weekend.

transcript.speaker: Sofia Alvarez
transcript.text: You too.

transcript.speaker: Priya Raman
transcript.text: Bye all.

transcript.speaker: Tom Becker
transcript.text: Bye.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Lee
transcript.text: Bye.

decisions.text: The next all-hands will be held in the office instead of a huddle
